tests.exactJourney: Keyboard-only: first load; deny location; choose manual area; open/close Settings and Alerts; search/select destination; start/stop/clear Route Watch; open/cancel report.
tests.inputMethod: Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Escape only
tests.observe: Visible focus, logical order, announced dynamic results with Narrator, focus enters overlays and returns to trigger, no trap/dead end.
tests.pass: Every essential action completes without pointer; focus is always visible and sensible; Narrator exposes names/states/results.
tests.fail: Any unreachable action, lost/hidden focus, trap, missing name/state, or unannounced blocking error.

tests.exactJourney: Touch: deny location, manually choose a county-qualified area, open Alerts, Show on Map, create/cancel a report, select destination and expand Destination Intelligence; rotate portrait/landscape.
tests.inputMethod: Touch plus Android large text/display scaling
tests.observe: Targets do not overlap; long labels wrap; content scrolls; no browser-chrome obstruction; state is understandable without color.
tests.pass: All actions remain reachable and readable in both orientations and large text with no horizontal page scroll or clipped action.
tests.fail: Obscured/overlapping target, clipped essential content, hover-only action, unrecoverable orientation state, or color-only meaning.

tests.deviceBrowser: iPhone with notch / current iOS Safari
tests.exactJourney: Touch + VoiceOver: first load/manual-area fallback; Alerts; search result to destination; report cancel; Settings open/change area/close; rotate once.
tests.inputMethod: Touch, VoiceOver swipe/activate, iOS text size increased
tests.observe: Safe areas and mobile chrome; control names/order; modal entry/exit; live result/status announcements; scroll reachability.
tests.pass: No notch/chrome obstruction; journeys complete; VoiceOver identifies controls/states and focus returns after overlays.
tests.fail: Covered action, inaccessible scroll endpoint, focus behind overlay, missing/incorrect announcement, or gesture-only essential map information.

tests.deviceBrowser: Same Android Chrome device / installed standalone PWA
tests.exactJourney: Install, cold launch, open Alerts, change My Area, choose destination, background/foreground, then relaunch.
tests.observe: Standalone launch/scope, safe-area reachability, navigation continuity, cached shell/update behavior, persisted preferences.
tests.pass: Launches standalone; controls remain reachable; no blank/stale shell; state survives expected lifecycle; online refresh works.
tests.fail: Install/launch failure, browser navigation escape, unreachable fixed control, blank shell, update loop, or lost expected state.
